text:
tara: Quick note - keyboard + SR flow for the canary traffic slider. On desktop mouse users can drag and see % but keyboard users can't discover the precise increments. Need suggestions for accessible scrubbing and clear microcopy.

kevin: Option 1: make the slider increment with arrow keys in 1% steps and show a live numeric input that accepts typed values. Focus should land on the numeric input for SR users.

anya: Option 2: provide +/- buttons adjacent to the slider for keyboard users and a visible label like 'Canary traffic: 10%'. Buttons are more discoverable.

aria-bot: A11y checklist: ensure slider has aria-valuemin/valuemax/valuenow, aria-label, and live region that announces changes. If using input, link with aria-describedby to show commitment and rollback behavior.

tara: Microcopy choices in Figma: A) 'Canary traffic — 10% (editable)' B) 'Traffic to canary: 10% — use arrows to adjust' C) 'Route 10% of traffic to canary (press Enter to save)'. Which is concise and clear?

anya: I like A for brevity, but add a tooltip for keyboard hints. Also include small confirmation toast saying 'Canary updated to 10% — Undo' to avoid surprises.

kevin: Implementation note: we'll expose both slider and number input; keyboard focus moves to number input after adjustments for SR. Telemetry: record method (slider drag, arrow keys, typed value) and undo rate.

tara: Action items: design to add +/- buttons and number input, copy A in figma with tooltip, eng to add aria attrs and telemetry flags, a11y to run SR walkthrough. We'll review Friday.

aria-bot: Accessibility review scheduled in 3 days.
